audit.why: 49.79% over 1872 games matches EVEN 5.5/10. Levels 1-5 are yours on range and lack of a lock; the map, not the lane, evens it at 6 when Destiny goes global at 5500 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..3].side all read 'Skill' while win[0..3] and the packet levelChart all read 'Orianna' — four cross-layer disagreements on the first four rows.
audit.why: Twisted Fate has no point-and-click threat until Pick a Card is ranked and a card is queued; the content layer and packet already say Orianna.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side set to Orianna with ratings recurved and each why rewritten to explain the verdict from the kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: The auto-reset tell on Pick a Card was never stated, and breakdown.cooldowns carried no digit.
audit.why: Riot's text: he chooses a card and uses it for his next attack. The kit's autoReset flag means the combo opens with an attack reset — the wind-up is the cue to step back, not the card cast. Pick a Card is a flat 6s, Wild Cards 6/5.75/5.5/5.25/5, Destiny 170/140/110.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No punishable window stated with a number.
audit.why: Pick a Card stays 6s at every rank while your Q falls from 7s to 3s — the gap after a spent card is where your full rotation lands for free.

The packet flagged 'Gold Card' in spikes[2] as a probable wrong name against 'Wild Cards' at distance 3 — false positive. Gold Card is one of Pick a Card's three selections, not a misspelling of Wild Cards. No edit made.

edits.before: Ball on the wave, autos on his face — your passive-stacked autos win level 1 against almost every mid. Place, don't throw.
edits.after: Your 815 Q out-ranges his auto and he has no lock at level 1 — place the ball on his last-hit spot and stack autos.

edits.before: Q-W online: the classic chunk combo. Trade it on his last-hits and keep the ball where his approach must cross it.
edits.after: Q-W online and he still has no reliable lock — trade on his last-hits and keep the ball on his approach line.

edits.before: E completes the kit: ball-on-self beats his engage, ball-on-wave farms, ball-on-him threatens. The chess match begins.
edits.after: Full Q-W-E now: land the ball on him as he last-hits, W through it, then recall for a second hit while he only farms.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-W every wave contact now. The Dissonance field controls every step he takes near the ball.
edits.after: You hold the wave through 4-5 and deny his Loaded Dice gold — shove him in and any card he holds is spent defending.

edits.before: Shockwave online — your lane presence doubles without casting anything. Every wave he contests is a potential flip.
edits.after: Destiny goes global at 5500 range and evens the map; your Shockwave only wins the fight you are standing in.

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-W chunks a third of his bar. Shove, rotate, and let the ball-delivery threat run the river fights.
edits.after: Both spikes arrive together — his is a gold-card pick, yours is zone control. Shove, rotate, and ping his roams.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Command: Protect for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Pick a Card: 6s at every rank — the lock-in is an auto-attack reset, so his wind-up is the cue to step back, not the card cast itself. Step up in its downtime. - Wild Cards is 6s and costs 100 mana at rank 5. - Destiny is 170s at level 6.

edits.before: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler doubles every gank.
edits.after: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Ball on your jungler adds shield, armour and MR to the dive.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: His Pick a Card stays 6s at every rank while your Q falls from 7s to 3s — in that gap land the ball, W through it, weave an auto.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: Your E is 9s and shields; your R is 110s and wins a fight. A gold card is an E problem — trading 110s for 6s is his best deal.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's Companion into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's Companion into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — buy the stopwatch the moment Destiny hits 6.

notes: Four full-layer chart rows disagreed with the content layer and the packet; sides, ratings and whys were moved together. The packet's suspectNames hit on 'Gold Card' is a false positive — it is a Pick a Card selection, not a mangled 'Wild Cards'. breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, ahead, breakdown.early, tradeGood and tradeBad remain structurally templated; the content layer already carries the Twisted Fate specifics (Loaded Dice denial, Destiny tracking, gold-card lock) so replacing them would have duplicated rather than added, and nothing further was verifiable from the kits.
